summary.text: Kyle Palmer is the Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 16-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Mark Klicker (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a third-generation Richland resident, a former chair of the Richland Planning Commission and a real estate professional.

paragraphs.text: Kyle Palmer graduated from Hanford High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Washington State University in 2007 and a graduate degree from Portland State University in 2010.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business operator.
He said his background includes service with AmeriCorps, a degree in social sciences from Washington State University and graduate studies in real estate development at Portland State.
Palmer listed increasing housing supply, expanding affordable childcare, strengthening infrastructure, supporting agriculture, and responsibly developing advanced energy as his priorities.
